description: This file implements the Moondream vision service, integrating a vision-language model for image analysis and description generation. It includes device detection, model loading, and asynchronous image processing.

classes.name: MoondreamService
classes.description: A service class for image analysis and description generation using the Moondream model, supporting hardware acceleration options.

methods.name: detect_device
methods.description: Detects available hardware acceleration (XPU, CUDA, MPS, CPU) and returns the appropriate device and data type.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the MoondreamService with model parameters and loads the model onto the appropriate device.

methods.name: run_vision
methods.description: Asynchronously processes an image frame to generate a descriptive text using the Moondream model.
